name: project
description: Prettify and format HTML inside PHP files with first-class Joomla (jdoc:include) and control structure support.

editor/context.when: editorTextFocus && (editorLangId == php || editorLangId == html || editorLangId == blade || editorLangId == phtml)

prettifyHtmlInPhp.indentWithTabs.description: Use tabs for indentation instead of spaces.

prettifyHtmlInPhp.preserveNewlines.description: Preserve empty newlines in the document.

prettifyHtmlInPhp.maxPreserveNewlines.description: Maximum number of consecutive empty lines to preserve.

prettifyHtmlInPhp.wrapLineLength.description: Maximum line length before wrapping attributes (0 to disable line wrapping).

prettifyHtmlInPhp.indentPhpControlStruct.description: Indent HTML and code inside PHP control structures (if/endif, foreach/endforeach, while/endwhile, switch/endswitch).

prettifyHtmlInPhp.joomlaRules.description: Enable specialized rules for Joomla templates (preserves <jdoc:include ... />, avoids cascading indentation, formats Joomla XML tags cleanly).

prettifyHtmlInPhp.formatPhpHeader.description: Format and align pure PHP preamble at the beginning of the file.
